Your coach

Matteo brings over 28 years of cycling experience, more than a decade of coaching riders around the world, and hundreds of race victories. He provides personalised coaching for road cycling, gravel, MTB, gran fondo and endurance riders, with every training plan built around your goals, your schedule and your lifestyle.

Whether you’re in England, Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland, training for a sportive like RideLondon, preparing for a gravel event, racing in your local league, or working towards your next British Cycling category upgrade, your coaching is fully tailored to help you perform at your best.

GMT/BST: calls and replies happen in your own day, not overnight.

Built for UK roads
Short steep climbs, wind, wet winters and the TT and sportive calendar.

Getting started from the UK

HOW IT WORKS

  1. 1

    Sign up or talk first

    Choose your package and sign up straight away, or book a free consultation with Matteo first. Ireland and the UK share a time zone, so a lunch break or an evening works.

  2. 2

    Testing & zones

    Every package starts with tests (CP, FTP, FTHR or INSCYD) to set your zones. On Advanced and Premium, Matteo also does a deep assessment of your last 6–12 months of training data.

  3. 3

    Your plan

    Sessions land in Vekta or TrainingPeaks and sync to your Garmin, Wahoo or Zwift: commute, club run and turbo nights included.

  4. 4

    Feedback

    On Advanced and Premium, Matteo reviews your sessions (weekly or daily) and adjusts the week around work, family and the weather.

Where we coach

Coaching Cyclists Across the UK

Matteo coaches riders remotely in every region and nation of the UK, including:

  • England — London, Yorkshire, the Cotswolds, Surrey Hills, Peak District, Lake District, South West
  • Scotland — Glasgow, Edinburgh, the Highlands, Perthshire
  • Wales — Cardiff, Brecon Beacons, Snowdonia
  • Northern Ireland — Belfast

The UK has some of the steepest climbs in Europe and a long, wet winter. Your plan uses both: hard, short efforts that suit the Peak District, the Lakes or the Welsh hills, and indoor sessions on the turbo when the roads are flooded.

Wherever you’re based, coaching is delivered the same way: personalised plan, remote feedback, and testing built around your local terrain and event calendar.

Good to know

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Which package is right for me?

It depends on your budget and how much direct feedback you want. Basic (£195, one payment for 12 weeks) is a plan you follow on your own. Advanced (£135/month) adds Matteo: weekly feedback and schedule changes, a monthly call and Vekta membership, and it is our most popular package. Premium is the closest coaching, with daily contact; it is full at the moment, but you can join the waiting list.

I'm based in the UK — does coaching work remotely?

Yes, entirely. Plans, feedback and test analysis are in Vekta or TrainingPeaks and calls are on video. Ireland and the UK are on the same clock all year (GMT in winter, BST in summer), so you talk to Matteo during your own day and replies come the same day, not overnight.

Do you only coach people who race?

No. We coach riders working towards weight loss, their first 100-mile sportive, a Fred Whitton finish, general fitness, triathlon, club time trials or road racing. The only requirement is that you ride a bike and want to improve.

Do I need to switch from Training Peaks to Vekta?

No — we can continue working in Training Peaks if you’re already comfortable there, or explore Vekta’s Critical Power and W′ analytics alongside it.

What age do I need to be?

We coach all ages, 14 and up — no upper limit. Riders under U23 receive a 20% student discount, so juniors racing their first British Cycling events pay less.

My event is months away — can I still sign up now?

Yes, and earlier is better. The big UK sportives are in late spring and summer (the Fred Whitton and Etape Caledonia in May, the Dragon Ride in June), so starting in the winter gives you a base block, a build block and a taper. Pick the package that fits the time you have.

Do you coach time trials and hill climbs?

Yes. Time trials and hill climbs are short, all-out efforts, and we train them that way: pacing work, efforts at and above Critical Power, and sessions in your race position. Advanced and Premium include race and pacing strategy for each event.

Online cycling coaching

CYCLING COACH UK

Train with Italian Head Coach Matteo Cigala — from anywhere in the UK.

Book free consultationSee the packages ↓
Your coach

Matteo brings over 28 years of cycling experience, more than a decade of coaching riders around the world, and hundreds of race victories. He provides personalised coaching for road cycling, gravel, MTB, gran fondo and endurance riders, with every training plan built around your goals, your schedule and your lifestyle.

Whether you’re in England, Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland, training for a sportive like RideLondon, preparing for a gravel event, racing in your local league, or working towards your next British Cycling category upgrade, your coaching is fully tailored to help you perform at your best.

Same time as Ireland
GMT/BST: calls and replies happen in your own day, not overnight.

Prices in pounds
You pay in pounds, so no exchange fees on your side.

Built for UK roads
Short steep climbs, wind, wet winters and the TT and sportive calendar.

Why riders choose us

Why UK Cyclists Choose Cigala Cycling Coaching

  • Personalised daily/weekly training plans built around Critical Power (CP) and W′ modelling — going beyond basic FTP training
  • Powered by Vekta, a next-generation training platform used by WorldTour teams (membership worth £17.99/month included free)
  • Training Peaks also available if you’re already set up there
  • Adaptive training zones that update as your fitness changes
  • Full support for sportives, Gran Fondos, time trials, road racing and general performance goals
  • Syncs with Garmin, Wahoo, Zwift and more
  • Nutritional guidance and access to a sports nutritionist and mental coach
  • Daily session carb recommendations
  • No minimum time zone friction — UK clients coach in real time with Matteo. Coaching is delivered 100% remotely.

Getting started from the UK

HOW IT WORKS

  1. 1

    Sign up or talk first

    Choose your package and sign up straight away, or book a free consultation with Matteo first. Ireland and the UK share a time zone, so a lunch break or an evening works.

  2. 2

    Testing & zones

    Every package starts with tests (CP, FTP, FTHR or INSCYD) to set your zones. On Advanced and Premium, Matteo also does a deep assessment of your last 6–12 months of training data.

  3. 3

    Your plan

    Sessions land in Vekta or TrainingPeaks and sync to your Garmin, Wahoo or Zwift: commute, club run and turbo nights included.

  4. 4

    Feedback

    On Advanced and Premium, Matteo reviews your sessions (weekly or daily) and adjusts the week around work, family and the weather.

Events We Help UK Riders Prepare For

Training toward a specific date changes everything about how a plan should be built. We coach riders preparing for sportives and Gran Fondos across the UK calendar, including:

  • Dragon Ride (Brecon Beacons, Wales) — the UK’s toughest sportive
  • Fred Whitton Challenge (Lake District)
  • Etape Caledonia (Scottish Highlands)
  • Tour of Cambridgeshire (UCI Gran Fondo World Series qualifier)
  • CiCLE Classic (Rutland/Leicestershire)
  • RideLondon-Essex (London to Essex)
  • Local club time trials, hill climbs and road race calendars run by British Cycling

Racing further afield — Mallorca 312, the Maratona dles Dolomites, Strade Bianche or a Gran Fondo World Championship qualifier? We build UK-based athletes’ training blocks around those targets too.

Where we coach

Coaching Cyclists Across the UK

Matteo coaches riders remotely in every region and nation of the UK, including:

  • England — London, Yorkshire, the Cotswolds, Surrey Hills, Peak District, Lake District, South West
  • Scotland — Glasgow, Edinburgh, the Highlands, Perthshire
  • Wales — Cardiff, Brecon Beacons, Snowdonia
  • Northern Ireland — Belfast

The UK has some of the steepest climbs in Europe and a long, wet winter. Your plan uses both: hard, short efforts that suit the Peak District, the Lakes or the Welsh hills, and indoor sessions on the turbo when the roads are flooded.

Wherever you’re based, coaching is delivered the same way: personalised plan, remote feedback, and testing built around your local terrain and event calendar.

Good to know

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Which package is right for me?

It depends on your budget and how much direct feedback you want. Basic (£195, one payment for 12 weeks) is a plan you follow on your own. Advanced (£135/month) adds Matteo: weekly feedback and schedule changes, a monthly call and Vekta membership, and it is our most popular package. Premium is the closest coaching, with daily contact; it is full at the moment, but you can join the waiting list.

I'm based in the UK — does coaching work remotely?

Yes, entirely. Plans, feedback and test analysis are in Vekta or TrainingPeaks and calls are on video. Ireland and the UK are on the same clock all year (GMT in winter, BST in summer), so you talk to Matteo during your own day and replies come the same day, not overnight.

Do you only coach people who race?

No. We coach riders working towards weight loss, their first 100-mile sportive, a Fred Whitton finish, general fitness, triathlon, club time trials or road racing. The only requirement is that you ride a bike and want to improve.

Do I need to switch from Training Peaks to Vekta?

No — we can continue working in Training Peaks if you’re already comfortable there, or explore Vekta’s Critical Power and W′ analytics alongside it.

What age do I need to be?

We coach all ages, 14 and up — no upper limit. Riders under U23 receive a 20% student discount, so juniors racing their first British Cycling events pay less.

My event is months away — can I still sign up now?

Yes, and earlier is better. The big UK sportives are in late spring and summer (the Fred Whitton and Etape Caledonia in May, the Dragon Ride in June), so starting in the winter gives you a base block, a build block and a taper. Pick the package that fits the time you have.

Do you coach time trials and hill climbs?

Yes. Time trials and hill climbs are short, all-out efforts, and we train them that way: pacing work, efforts at and above Critical Power, and sessions in your race position. Advanced and Premium include race and pacing strategy for each event.
